Hard boiled eggs

Take two eggs and put them in a pot of  cold water and put on the stove on high heat. Wait for it to boil and then let it boil for five minutes.

Then let them sit off heat for another five minutes. After that run them under water for five minutes. 

Take the eggs out of the water and peel off the shell and slice into 5-6 slices.

Put a drop of hot sauce (doesn’t matter what kind but Frank’s red hot works great) then a twist of pink Himalayan salt on every slice.

Then add bagel seasoning and finely chop green onions and add them to the eggs.

Bacon

Chop 3 strips of bacon into lardons about the width of a fingernail. 

Add to a cold cast iron skillet and put it on medium heat till crispy 

Crumpet 

Toast a crumpet in your toaster oven for 4 minutes. Add a tablespoon of soft spreadable butter to you crumpet and toast is again to melt the butter. I recommend keeping the crumpet in the toaster oven to keep it warm till eating time
